alex: quick heads-up: rolled a burst-smoothing + eviction-floor tweak to a 5% canary on prod-blue at 14:03 UTC. goal: cut short-request latency tail and reduce wasted token padding during sharp bursts. :zap:
nina: what are the concrete changes?
alex: two small runtime knobs: (a) microbatcher now enables burst_smoothing which defers tiny windows for up to 6ms to increase coalescing when QPS spikes; (b) kvcache low-water floor set to 10% specifically for discovery and quick-reply prefixes to avoid thrash during microbursts.
raj: bench numbers? did you run the synthetic + live-replay?
alex: ran 45m live-replay + synthetic fanout. Highlights for short requests (<24 tokens): p50 9ms -> 4ms (~56%); p95 45ms -> 30ms (~33%); p99 260ms -> 200ms (~23%). Token cost per 1M tokens decreased ~15% in the replay (less filler tokens and fewer single-request microbatches).
olga: any impact on medium/long sequences or KV hit rates?
alex: KV hit-rate stayed stable overall. Observed a small p99 bump for 256-512 token mix on one AZ during the first 10m of canary (290ms -> 320ms). Root cause traced to an interaction with an older kernel scheduler + microbatch drain timing causing brief CPU jitter on that AZ. After we bumped the kernel and disabled a noisy daemon, the spike disappeared.
nina: can you paste the config so QE and SRE can repro?
alex: pasted below:```json
{
  "microbatch": {"burst_smoothing_ms": 6, "min_coalesce_tokens": 2},
  "kvcache": {"low_water_pct": 10, "target_prefixes": ["/quick_reply", "/discover"]}
}```
raj: perf-run id and dashboard?
perf-bot: perf-run id perf_2026_04_05_1403 - dashboard https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1761112222 - traces and histograms attached. :white_check_mark:
nina: rollout plan? slow or fast?
alex: propose slow staged expansion: 5% -> 20% (30m) -> 50% (1h) -> 100% with a p99 gate per region. rollback flags: disable burst_smoothing or restore old low_water_pct. I'll open the rollout ticket and include a checklist.
raj: please add a smoke test that injects a 200req/s microburst of short requests to ensure no regressions on p50/p95 and a medium-seq probe for p99.
olga: ops window midnight UTC ok? @raj @nina
raj: I'm good. nina: OK.
alex: TL;DR: burst-smoothing + eviction-floor -> ~50% p50 improvement for short requests, ~15% token cost reduction; minor medium-seq tail observed due to older kernel on one AZ, fixed by kernel bump; staged rollout planned tonight. Will upload final artifacts and an updated perf-playbook note after full rollout. :tada:
